title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England filed for review and an approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy of a Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Newton Wellesley Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. The Comnmissoners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners; James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Brian Paul Golden, and Soo Kim. (D.T.E. 06-GC-24)
